# GRAMSuite paths for jobs that build and call native GRAM: the coverage shards,
# example shards, example regression, telemetry (quick and full), nightly
# stress. Git sparse-checkout patterns (non-cone), relative to
# data/GRAMSuite.jl; paths only, never data.
# Measured on runs 36488347445 and 36488347487 (2026-09-28): at most 466 files
# (400 MB) of the 5316 (17.8 GB) are read, namely the build tree (Build/,
# common/, each planet's source, include, unittest and examples), the SPICE
# kernels, Mars/data, Earth/data/modeldata and two MERRA-2 monthly means.
# Left out, all unread: the hourly MERRA-2 files (9.7 GB), the offline static
# grids (2.5 GB), the planetary surrogate files, the documentation and the
# Windows/MSVS/Python trees. All twelve monthly means are kept (1.2 GB) so a
# scenario in another month still finds its file.
# Every pattern without a wildcard must exist after the checkout.
